feature: D3 Layer 1 experiment — symptom-first prompt (H1) + changed-line evidence forcing (H4) + mechanism evaluator loop (T3)
problem: D3=0.230 at V1 n=50. 91% of D3=0 failures are wrong-mechanism: agent cites correct files but wrong causal chain. Root cause: abstraction bias (LLM applies familiar code pattern template instead of reasoning from changed lines). The fix: (1) restructure prompt to reason from observable symptom first; (2) require +/- changed line citation in evidence; (3) loop to challenge context-only citations.
proposed_solution: Add HYPOTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT_H1H4T3 to hypothesis_engine.py: (H1) mechanism field starts from user-observable failure before code structure; (H4) evidence_quote must cite at least one +/- prefixed changed line for primary mechanism. Add mechanism_evaluator_loop() in hypothesis_engine.py: after first LLM call, check if primary hypotheses cite +/- lines; if not, send targeted challenge and re-run (max 2 rounds, deterministic criterion — no LLM in evaluator). Add enable_mechanism_evaluator: bool flag to AgentOrchestrator. Add experiment script scripts/run_d3_experiment_layer1.py to run hard panel n=18 with baseline vs H1H4T3 variant and report D3 delta.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: hypothesis_engine.py exports HYPOTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT_H1H4T3 — a variant of the current prompt with: (a) mechanism field description requires format 'Observable: [user-visible failure]. Root change: [+/- line]. Mechanism: [causal chain at file:area]'; (b) new CHANGED-LINE EVIDENCE section stating primary mechanism evidence_quote must contain at least one line starting with + or -.

AC-2: hypothesis_engine.py exports _has_changed_line_citation(evidence_quote: str) -> bool that returns True iff evidence_quote contains at least one line matching ^[+-] (not +++ or --- header lines). Unit tested: empty string→False, context-only quote→False, quote with +line→True, quote with -line→True, quote with diff header (+++/---)→False.

AC-3: hypothesis_engine.py exports mechanism_evaluator_loop() that wraps complete_with_parse_retry: after first LLM response, checks primary hypotheses (first 3) for changed-line citation; if any have a non-empty evidence_quote with no +/- line, appends a targeted challenge message naming the mechanism and re-runs (max 2 rounds total). Returns on first pass if all primary hypotheses have empty or grounded evidence_quotes.

AC-4: AgentOrchestrator accepts enable_mechanism_evaluator: bool = False. When True, investigate() uses mechanism_evaluator_loop() with HYPOTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT_H1H4T3 instead of the current complete_with_parse_retry() + HYPOTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT. When False, behavior is identical to current (no regression).

AC-5: scripts/run_d3_experiment_layer1.py runs both variants (baseline, h1h4t3) on the hard panel commits defined in .harness/state.json v2_baseline.hard_panel. Outputs a table: commit | baseline_D3 | h1h4t3_D3 | delta. Reports aggregate: n_improved, n_regressed, mean_delta_D3.
AC-6: pytest -q passes (all existing tests + new tests for AC-2 + AC-3). Minimum 6 new test cases covering _has_changed_line_citation and mechanism_evaluator_loop.
edge_cases: EC-1: All primary hypotheses already have empty evidence_quote (model returned no quotes) — evaluator does NOT challenge, returns immediately. Correct behavior: empty quote is not a context-only quote.

EC-2: Model returns same wrong evidence_quote after challenge (max_rounds=2 hit) — evaluator returns whatever was returned on round 2 without infinite loop. Must be covered by a test with a mock LLM that always returns context-only quotes.
EC-3: enable_mechanism_evaluator=False (baseline mode) — mechanism_evaluator_loop is never called, original HYPOTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT is used. Existing test suite must pass unchanged.
EC-4: Diff header lines (+++ b/file or --- a/file) must NOT count as changed-line citations — they are metadata, not code changes. _has_changed_line_citation must filter them out.
verification_method: (1) pytest tests/ -q — exit 0, ≥6 new test cases pass; (2) python -c "from commit_investigator.hypothesis_engine import HYPOTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT_H1H4T3, _has_changed_line_citation, mechanism_evaluator_loop; print('imports OK')"; (3) python -c "from commit_investigator.orchestrator import AgentOrchestrator; o=AgentOrchestrator(enable_mechanism_evaluator=True); print('flag OK')"; (4) python scripts/run_d3_experiment_layer1.py --dry-run — prints table with all hard panel commit IDs (no LLM calls, uses mock data)
